title: Extend readiness timeout when agent-server runs repository setup hooks
answers: Why does a cloud run fail with 'Agent-server failed to start' on repos with Claude Code SessionStart hooks?
How to handle slow repository initialization hooks during agent-server startup?
What causes launch retries to fail with 'Failed to prepare agent-server launch' on slow repositories?
body:
Symptom: Cloud runs fail with "Agent-server failed to start" followed by "Failed to prepare agent-server launch" on repositories with slow Claude Code SessionStart hooks.
Root cause: products/tasks/backend/logic/services/sandbox.py:build_health_check_command fixed readiness polling to 120s while products/desktop/packages/agent/src/server/agent-server.ts:AgentServer allows hooks up to 10 minutes.
Fix pattern: Poll initializationPhase from /health and dynamically extend max attempts and timeout budget when the agent reports setup_hooks.
Constraints: Only extends the budget when /health returns initializationPhase: "setup_hooks"; absent or other phases retain the default 120s budget.
applies: Agent-server health check loop and startup readiness in sandbox services
says: Cloud coding workspace fails to launch on repositories with slow setup scripts
Agent startup times out before initial repository preparation hooks finish executing
Allow extra startup time when project onboarding scripts require longer to run
Cloud tasks report launch failure instead of waiting for repository initialization
